summary.text: CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig said in October 2026 that superintelligence holds the promise to transform the global economy and financial markets. He announced the CFTC’s inaugural Frontier Forum as a venue to discuss the opportunities and risks posed by superintelligence. Selig said America must dominate compute markets to win the AI race and that the CFTC is working with the Commerce Department on compute products; in a March 2026 speech he said a robust compute market could further policy and that the CFTC is working to make the U.S. a global leader in that market. He said smart AI regulatory policy is critical to America winning the AI race and that under his leadership the CFTC will apply the minimum effective dose of regulation, while also saying laws and regulations should accommodate AI innovators.
